[IRET.28.3.1] **`dcap == cap`.** The dense arrays are sized to `cap`.
Because `len < cap` always (load < 100 %), dense index `[0,len)` always
fits. The implementation **must** grow `slots` and the dense arrays
together on one growth path. The cost is a `(1 - load)·cap` unused dense
tail (≤ 30 % at 70 % load); see `[IRET.28.14]`.
